name: warren-version-bump-trinity
description: Releasing warren: bump (1) package.json 'version', (2) src/index.ts VERSION const, (3) write CHANGELOG.md entry between [Unreleased] and prior version. No bump script — edit both files manually; .github/workflows/release.yml fails the release job if they disagree, then auto-tags v$VERSION and creates a GitHub release from the matching CHANGELOG section. Run trinity (bun test && bun run lint && bun run typecheck) and commit; warren reaps and pushes.

content: Patch releases: edit package.json + src/index.ts VERSION directly (no version:bump script exists in warren, unlike burrow). Move CHANGELOG [Unreleased] items to a new version section with today's date. Quality gates (bun test && lint && typecheck) gate the commit.

description: Releasing warren regenerates docs/openapi.yaml because gen:openapi embeds package.json version into info.version. After bumping package.json + src/index.ts VERSION, run 'bun run gen:openapi' (and 'bun run gen:docs' for safety) before check:all — otherwise gen:openapi:check fails inside check:all and the release commit is blocked.
resolution: After version bump in package.json + src/index.ts, run 'bun run gen:openapi && bun run gen:docs' before check:all so the generated docs match the new version.

description: check:coverage fails locally in a fresh burrow with 'Cannot find package zod/drizzle-orm/js-yaml/pino/pg' errors: 164 tests fail at module load, depressing Bun's function-coverage aggregate (~85.7%) below the 87.09 floor. The bun-version mismatch (.bun-version pins 1.3.14; burrow had 1.2.23) is a red herring — coverage barely moves across versions.
resolution: Run 'bun install' first — deps were not installed in the sandbox. With deps present all 2433 tests pass and coverage is 88.45% funcs / 91.46% lines, clearing the floor. Always 'bun install' before trusting a red coverage/test gate in a fresh burrow.

content: Minor (not patch) bumps are reserved for user-facing surface changes (e.g. the pl-0008 Workspace collapse: 0.8.10 -> 0.9.0); the release.md flow defaults to patch otherwise. After bumping package.json + src/index.ts, always 'bun run gen:openapi' since the OpenAPI doc embeds the package version and gen:openapi:check will fail CI otherwise.

Version-bump seeds may land before their nominal 'land last after X PRs merge' gate if X is unmerged: write the CHANGELOG to summarize only what actually merged on main, not the seed's aspirational scope (e.g. 0.9.1 shipped the workspace chat + transcript fixes but the pl-f700 logging seeds were still open).

name: version-bump-rollback
description: version-bump computes rewrites in memory then writes, rolls back all on failure (warren-16b5)

content: warren's version lives in package.json, src/index.ts, docs/openapi.yaml (via gen:openapi), and the README ## Status semver — bun run version:bump is the single entry point; do not hand-edit.

title: CHANGELOG curation stays human
rationale: CHANGELOG is 250KB+ and most commits are agent PRs that do not deserve a line; per-PR enforcement worsens bloat

content: A version-site regex must not let an optional prerelease suffix end on '.' or '-', or a sentence-final period ('>= 0.3.15.') gets captured into the semver.

title: Canonical-per-group version drift model
rationale: The published image runs what the Dockerfile installs, so the Dockerfile is truth for the burrow pin; package.json is truth for the release version

title: Only the control-plane image goes to ghcr.io
rationale: warren-agent / warren-workspace-init run only on GKE; a moving :X.Y tag must never resolve to an rc

content: check:ci-parity only globs .github/workflows/ci*.yml, so release.yml gate steps are unguarded by it — manifest drift there needs its own test (scripts/release-hardening.test.ts).

description: Quoting the version-bump draft sentinel verbatim in CHANGELOG prose collides with stripExistingDraft
resolution: Write the marker in prose without comment delimiters; the 'leaves the real CHANGELOG.md parseable' test guards it

content: Live CHANGELOG.md keeps recent minors; docs/CHANGELOG-archive.md is frozen with no [Unreleased] heading so the bumper can never target it, and links back with ../CHANGELOG.md.
Release headings use '## [X.Y.Z] — YYYY-MM-DD' (em dash), matching 60+ prior entries; release.yml's awk anchors only on '^## \[VERSION\]' so the separator is free but consistency is the convention.
